decks.notes: This Doomsday Combo Vintage deck focuses on quickly assembling the key cards needed to win the game in a single turn. The deck includes efficient card draw spells, permission spells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, and the necessary pieces for the Doomsday combo - Doomsday itself, Thassa's Oracle, and alternate win conditions such as Tendrils of Agony. The deck aims to set up a winning Doomsday pile by manipulating the top of the library and using the combo pieces effectively to secure a victory.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the graveyard efficiently to quickly power out threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad, Golgari Thug, and Shambling Shell, the deck can fuel its graveyard with key creatures like Narcomoeba, Ichorid, and Prized Amalgam. Utilizing the Dredge mechanic and various graveyard synergies, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive threats and disruption. Additionally, cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation provide additional protection and disruption against opposing strategies.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage through powerful spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time. The deck utilizes a mix of counterspells, removal, and disruptive artifacts like Wasteland and Pithing Needle to control the game. Additionally, the deck includes powerful mana acceleration in the form of Black Lotus and the Moxen to allow for powerful plays like casting Time Walk multiple times in a turn. The inclusion of Lurrus as a companion adds additional value by allowing certain cards to be recurred from the graveyard.

This Dimir Control deck aims to dominate the game by using disruption spells like Force of Will and Mental Misstep, paired with card advantage tools like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time. The deck also includes powerful artifacts like Black Lotus and Moxen to accelerate mana production. With Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion, the deck can grind out value by recurring its threats and answers. Overall, the deck focuses on controlling the game through counter magic, removal, and powerful card draw while maintaining a proactive game plan.

The main concept of this Bazaar Aggro deck is to aggressively use cards like Bazaar of Baghdad to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures such as Basking Rootwalla and Vengevine, allowing for explosive plays and strong board presence. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its strategy, along with removal options like Force of Vigor. By utilizing graveyard synergy and efficient creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive game plan in the Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on applying early pressure with aggressive creatures like Tarmogoyf and Deathrite Shaman, while disrupting opponents with cards like Force of Will and Abrupt Decay. It also utilizes powerful draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time to maintain card advantage. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Oko, Thief of Crowns and Collector Ouphe, while also utilizing disruptive cards like Strip Mine and Wasteland to disrupt opponents' mana base. The deck is a versatile midrange deck that can adapt to different matchups and play styles.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on using powerful control spells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage through cards like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time. The deck also utilizes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and versatile threats like Orcish Bowmasters. With access to powerful artifacts like Time Vault and Moxen, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent through a combination of disruption, card advantage, and efficient threats.

This Dimir Control deck aims to maintain board control and disrupt the opponent's plans using a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and disruptive spells. With a focus on card advantage and tempo advantage, the deck leverages efficient threats like Orcish Bowmasters and Lórien Revealed to pressure opponents while disrupting their game plan. The deck also includes powerful artifacts like Black Lotus and Moxen for ramp and acceleration. Overall, the deck excels at controlling the game, setting the pace, and outmaneuvering opponents to secure victory.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to establish control of the game through a combination of countermagic, card advantage, and disruption. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Will and Fatal Push, while also generating card advantage through spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time. Additionally, the deck includes powerful artifacts like Sol Ring, Black Lotus, and Time Vault to accelerate its game plan and maintain control of the board.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the Coveted Jewel combo, using Paradoxical Outcome and Mishra's Workshop to generate mana and card advantage. The deck also includes key pieces like Tinker, Karn, the Great Creator, and Time Vault to support the combo strategy. With powerful artifacts like Black Lotus, Mana Crypt, and Moxen to accelerate the game plan, this deck is designed to overwhelm opponents with fast mana and game-winning combos before they can establish their own game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing the graveyard as a resource to quickly and consistently fill the board with powerful creatures like Ichorid, Narcomoeba, and Prized Amalgam. By utilizing cards like Creeping Chill and Hollow One, the deck can deal damage directly to the opponent while maintaining a strong board presence. Additionally, the deck includes disruption in the form of Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of speed, resilience, and disruptive elements.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of artifact creatures and disruptive artifacts, creating a lock on the game and slowing down the opponent's strategy. By utilizing Mishra's Workshop, Golos, Tireless Pilgrim, and Urza's Saga to generate mana, the deck can quickly deploy threats like Nettlecyst and Patchwork Automaton. Sphere of Resistance, Trinisphere, Thorn of Amethyst, and Chalice of the Void further disrupt the opponent's game plan, while Null Rod shuts down opposing artifacts. Crucible of Worlds and Wasteland provide additional land destruction, and Strip Mine and Ghost Quarter can disrupt the opponent's mana base.

The main idea of this deck is to pressure the opponent quickly with aggressive creatures while disrupting their game plan with cards like Phyrexian Revoker, Trinisphere, and Thorn of Amethyst. By utilizing artifacts like Golos, Tireless Pilgrim and Crucible of Worlds, the deck aims to generate value and lock down the opponent's resources. The inclusion of cards like Nettlecyst and Soul-Guide Lantern also helps to further disrupt the opponent's strategies. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive threats and disruptive elements.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting opponents with counterspells while utilizing efficient card draw spells and mana acceleration to maintain control of the game. The deck also includes a strong artifact package, featuring utility cards like Manifold Key and Time Vault, alongside powerful disruption tools like Lurrus of the Dream-Den and Wasteland. The goal is to out-value and out-tempo the opponent, while disrupting their game plan and establishing a dominant board presence through a combination of card advantage and disruptive elements.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of efficient spells and disruptive creatures to control the game while applying pressure to the opponent. By leveraging powerful spells like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk alongside disruptive elements like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade and Swords to Plowshares, the deck aims to establish an early advantage and maintain it throughout the game. The inclusion of cards like Dreadhorde Arcanist and Orcish Bowmasters allows for recurring threats and additional pressure, while the mana base ensures consistent access to the necessary colors and resources.

This deck focuses on utilizing the powerful card Paradoxical Outcome to generate card advantage and mana acceleration by bouncing multiple artifacts back to the owner's hand. By leveraging artifacts like Moxen, mana rocks, and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to generate a large amount of mana and card draw in order to storm off and win the game with cards like Tendrils of Agony or Bolas's Citadel. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Will and Geralf, the Fleshwright to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.
